sentences.text:
This Writ Petition is filed questioning the reference letter in Rc.No.A/7035/2016-6, dated 30.05.2022 of the respondent No.4 in referring the claim relating to payment of compensation for acquisition of petitioners land in Sy.No.388/2 to an extent of Ac.1-07 guntas, Sy. No.388/AA2 to an extent of Ac.1-07 guntas and Sy.No.388/AA/1 to an extent of Ac.0-27 guntas situated at Indaram Village of Jaipur Mandal, Mancherial District u/s 77(2) of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short, "the Act,
2013") to the respondent No.2 based on the objection raised by the respondent No. 6 in spite of the rejection of the objection of the respondent No.6 by order dated 31-12-2020 as illegal and arbitrary.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the issue involved in this writ petition is squarely covered by the order dated 09.06.2023 in W.P.No.36006 of 2022 and the same was confirmed by a Division Bench of this Court in W.A.No.1010 of 2023 dated 18.10.2023 and the same is not disputed by the learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition for the official respondent Nos.1 to 4, Sri P.
Sri Harsha Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for the respondent No.5 and Sri D.V.Srinivasa Rao,
learned counsel for the respondent No.6.
3.

In view of the said submissions and for the reasons assigned by the learned Single Judge of this Court by order dated 09.06.2023 in W.P.No.36006 of 2022 as confirmed by a Division Bench of this Court in W.A.No.1010 of 2023 dated 18.10.2023, the Writ Petition is allowed, thereby the reference letter in Rc.No.A/7035/2016-6, dated 30.05.2022 of the respondent No.4 in referring the claim relating to payment of compensation for acquisition of petitioners land in Sy.No.388/2 to an extent of Ac.1-07 guntas, Sy. No.388/AA2 to an extent of Ac.1-07 guntas and Sy.No.388/AA/1 to an extent of Ac.0-27 guntas situated at Indaram Village of Jaipur Mandal, Mancherial District u/s 77(2) of the Act, 2013 to respondent No.2 are set aside.

Consequently, the petitioners are entitled to receive the compensation as awarded and the respondents are further directed to take all necessary steps to pay compensation awarded together with interest accrued, if any as expeditiously as possible, at any rate, within a period of six (6) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
There shall be no order as to costs.
4. Miscellaneous Applications, if any pending in these writ petitions, shall stand closed.

_ __ JUSTICE K.SARATH Date:09.01.2024 EDS THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE K.SARATH WRIT PETITION No.26648 of 2023 Date:09.01.2024 EDS Vennempally Ramesh vs The State Of Telangana, on 9 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56482771/
